Manage service-account (non-interactive) certificate enrollment.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh service [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoossh config file |
| `--server` | string |  | server address including scheme (e.g. "https://example.com") assumes https if omited. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh service enroll`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/service-enroll/) | Enroll a service keypair for unattended certificate issuance. |
| [`ssoossh service retrieve`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/service-retrieve/) | Retrieve a service certificate using a previously issued enrollment code. |
